# Eximo BD

> Study abroad, work visa, skilled migration, residency and language-course advisory for students, workers and professionals from Bangladesh. Official office: Via Francesco Ravaschio 97, Sestri Ponente, Genova, Italy. Phone / WhatsApp: +880 1577-744190. Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/eximobd. Information last reviewed November 2026.

Eximo advises Bangladeshi nationals on study, work, tourist, family and medical visas for 20 countries, overseas employment, skilled migration, digital nomad visas, residency and citizenship by investment (with licensed partner lawyers), and language courses (IELTS, German, Japanese, Korean, Italian) through partner institutes. Visa decisions are made only by governments; overseas employment is processed through BMET-licensed recruiting agencies.

## Services
- [Work abroad from Bangladesh](https://www.eximobd.com/work-abroad.html): largest destinations for Bangladeshi workers (2025 BMET data), routes, departure process, fraud warnings
- [Skilled migration](https://www.eximobd.com/skilled-migration.html): Canada Express Entry, Australia 189/190/491, New Zealand, UK, Germany, Ireland
- [Digital nomad visas](https://www.eximobd.com/digital-nomad.html): remote-work visas open to Bangladeshi applicants
- [Residency & second citizenship](https://www.eximobd.com/residency-citizenship.html): investment programmes and rules for Bangladeshi nationals
- [Language courses](https://www.eximobd.com/languages.html): IELTS, German, Japanese, Korean, Italian
- [Scholarships](https://www.eximobd.com/scholarships.html): funded study abroad for Bangladeshi students
- [All destinations compared](https://www.eximobd.com/destinations.html)

## Visa types
- [Student visas from Bangladesh](https://www.eximobd.com/visas/study.html): Admissions, scholarships and the student visa that follows.
- [Work visas from Bangladesh](https://www.eximobd.com/visas/work.html): Skilled-worker routes, employer sponsorship and points-based migration.
- [Tourist & visit visas from Bangladesh](https://www.eximobd.com/visas/tourist.html): Holiday, business-visitor and short family-visit applications.
- [Family & dependant visas from Bangladesh](https://www.eximobd.com/visas/family.html): Spouse, partner, children and parent visas — and dependants of students and workers.
- [Medical treatment visas from Bangladesh](https://www.eximobd.com/visas/medical.html): Treatment visas for patients and attendants, with hospital coordination.

## Country guides
- [United Kingdom](https://www.eximobd.com/countries/uk.html): One-year master's degrees and a post-study work route.
- [United States](https://www.eximobd.com/countries/usa.html): Research universities, STEM funding and OPT work rights.
- [Canada](https://www.eximobd.com/countries/canada.html): College and university options with clear routes to residence.
- [Australia](https://www.eximobd.com/countries/australia.html): Strong universities, part-time work rights and skilled migration.
- [Germany](https://www.eximobd.com/countries/germany.html): Low or no tuition at public universities and a strong job market.
- [Ireland](https://www.eximobd.com/countries/ireland.html): English-speaking EU hub for tech, pharma and finance.
- [New Zealand](https://www.eximobd.com/countries/new-zealand.html): Smaller classes, a safe lifestyle and clear skilled-residence routes.
- [Malaysia](https://www.eximobd.com/countries/malaysia.html): Affordable degrees, branch campuses of UK and Australian universities.
- [Japan](https://www.eximobd.com/countries/japan.html): MEXT scholarships, language schools and a growing skilled-worker programme.
- [South Korea](https://www.eximobd.com/countries/south-korea.html): GKS scholarships, tech universities and the EPS work programme.
- [United Arab Emirates](https://www.eximobd.com/countries/uae.html): Tax-free salaries, branch campuses and long-term residence options.
- [Singapore](https://www.eximobd.com/countries/singapore.html): World-ranked universities and a global finance and tech hub.
- [India](https://www.eximobd.com/countries/india.html): The most popular choice for medical treatment from Bangladesh.
- [Thailand](https://www.eximobd.com/countries/thailand.html): Internationally accredited hospitals and affordable international programmes.
- [Saudi Arabia](https://www.eximobd.com/countries/saudi-arabia.html): The largest overseas job market for Bangladeshi workers by a wide margin.
- [Qatar](https://www.eximobd.com/countries/qatar.html): Second-largest destination for Bangladeshi workers in 2025, with pre-departure processing in Dhaka.
- [Kuwait](https://www.eximobd.com/countries/kuwait.html): A steady Gulf market for domestic, services and cooperative-society jobs.
- [Maldives](https://www.eximobd.com/countries/maldives.html): Resort, construction and fisheries jobs a short flight from Dhaka.
- [Italy](https://www.eximobd.com/countries/italy.html): Europe's main legal work channel for Bangladeshis, plus income-based DSU scholarships.
- [Romania](https://www.eximobd.com/countries/romania.html): Employer-sponsored jobs in construction, logistics and food services inside the EU.
